name: Travel to Darkshire
summary: Travel to Darkshire is an emissary mission directing Alliance adventurers from Stormwind City into the haunted forest of Duskwood. Dispatched by the visiting draenei Emissary Taluun, the journey connects the capital to the isolated frontier outpost of Darkshire to aid Anchorite Delan and the besieged locals.

sections.title: A Plea Across the Kingdom
sections.body: While walking the streets of Stormwind, newly arrived draenei representatives take note of the kingdom's struggles. Emissary Taluun learns of Duskwood, an afflicted region southeast of Elwynn Forest wracked by undead monstrosities and forgotten curses. Eager to foster goodwill and alleviate suffering, Taluun asks travelers to carry their devotion into the field, directing them toward the remote town of Darkshire where another anchorite has already journeyed.

sections.title: The Peril of the Dark Forest
sections.body: Darkshire stands as the lonely heart of Duskwood, surrounded by gloom and prowling predators. Upon reaching the settlement, Anchorite Delan greets visiting adventurers with solemn relief. The anchorite quickly confirms that the local human townsfolk are pressed on all sides by ravenous undead and lurking beasts, urging arriving champions to walk the streets, listen to the residents' desperate pleas, and offer whatever strength they can muster.

faq.answer: Emissary Taluun, a draenei envoy stationed in Stormwind City, gives you the task. Seeking to assist the human kingdom with its internal struggles, Taluun directs able adventurers to Duskwood to support the besieged population.

faq.q: Who do you meet when you arrive in Darkshire?
aliases: who do i speak to in darkshire
faq.answer: You meet Anchorite Delan, a spiritual guide stationed directly in Darkshire. Delan is working to bring comfort and assistance to the frightened citizens and encourages travelers to aid the town in driving back the surrounding shadows.

Darkshire is the last civilized haven in Duskwood, a region smothered in perpetual twilight and overrun by undead, feral worgen, and hostile predators. With Stormwind's military stretched thin, the local Night Watch struggles to defend the settlement alone.

faq.q: What route leads from Stormwind to Darkshire?
faq.answer: Adventurers typically travel east through Elwynn Forest to the Eastvale Logging Camp or head south over the river into Duskwood. Following the road south and east through the dark canopy brings you directly into the square of Darkshire.

faq.q: What should you do after completing this journey?
faq.answer: Anchorite Delan encourages you to explore Darkshire and speak with its inhabitants. The town council, the Night Watch, and various troubled residents offer numerous tasks to root out the darkness threatening the region.

faq.q: Why are draenei anchorites involved in Duskwood?
faq.answer: Following their recent arrival on Azeroth and entry into the Alliance, draenei envoys and priests are keen to demonstrate solidarity with the kingdom of Stormwind by extending spiritual healing and tactical assistance to its most endangered settlements.

angles.text: This journey represents the growing bond among Alliance peoples, as draenei visitors actively step forward to help stabilize one of Stormwind's most imperiled borderlands.
Anchorites and priests share a dedication to the Light, making this mission to comfort the haunted folk of Darkshire a natural pilgrimage of service.
With Duskwood besieged by rampant undead, paladins answering Taluun's call find an urgent duty to cleanse the dark forest and protect its vulnerable defenders.
